request: Response to RFP NW-2025-014: Vendor Onboarding Platform for Northwind Logistics
scale: 0-10 per criterion; bands are the acceptable range for a competent scorer

key_facts: SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certifications
immutable audit log retained for seven years
apex_systems.pdf.profile: Strong technical design and security; higher price; moderate delivery schedule.

rationale.1: Detailed event-driven architecture, tested throughput, named connectors and sandboxes.
rationale.2: Phased 28-week plan with milestones and a defined team, but a longer schedule and no risk register.
rationale.3: Transparent itemised fixed price with assumptions, but the highest total of the field.
rationale.4: SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001, encryption, customer-managed keys, seven-year audit log, annual pen test.
rationale.5: Nine similar projects and two named references, but standard support is business hours only.

key_facts: ISO certification is planned for next year
Integration costs will be quoted separately
not yet been performed for volumes above 500 vendors
brightpath_tech.pdf.profile: Lowest price and fast timeline; weak compliance detail and limited experience.

rationale.1: Standard product with file-based integration; no scalability evidence beyond 500 vendors.
rationale.2: Short, clear 14-week phasing but no milestones, named roles or risk plan.
rationale.3: Lowest price but integration is excluded, so total cost is unclear; assumptions are thin.
rationale.4: Generic 'best practices' claims; certification only planned; no controls or audit detail.
rationale.5: Email-only support, two small projects, no references provided.

key_facts: ISO 27001 certification audit is scheduled for the second quarter
cut onboarding time from 12 days to 4
nexaworks.pdf.profile: Balanced proposal; strongest implementation plan and support model.

rationale.1: Sound modular architecture and production scale (2,500 vendors) but less technical depth than Apex.
rationale.2: Six milestones with owners and acceptance, RACI, top-five risk register, weekly governance.
rationale.3: Clear fixed price, defined inclusions and an itemised optional extra at a mid-range total.
rationale.4: SOC 2 Type II and annual pen tests; ISO 27001 still pending; shorter log retention.
rationale.5: 24x7 tiered support with SLA table and credits, named CSM, hypercare, referenceable outcomes.

key_facts: Technical details will be finalised in the design phase
Milestones will be agreed at kickoff
Integration work is covered by an allowance
orbit_digital.pdf.profile: Strong experience and references; vague integration plan; medium pricing.

rationale.1: Generic platform description; integration approach is deferred to the design phase.
rationale.2: Approximate 26 weeks, no milestones, no named roles beyond a manager and a lead, no risk plan.
rationale.3: Mid-range total, but the integration allowance is open-ended and assumptions are minimal.
rationale.4: ISO 27001 certified, but controls, logging and testing are described only in general terms.
rationale.5: Fourteen implementations and five named, contactable references; support is weekdays only.
